title: EMA 4-line align + rising/falling grid multi-group (mq4)
entry_long: EMA100 rising (candle ID1>ID2); EMA45>EMA100 and EMA8>EMA45 at ID1 (bullish fan); EMA3 crosses above EMA8; price-to-EMA3 distance <=50 pips; hour filter 13:00-20:00 server time; weekday Mon-Fri, weekends off
entry_short: mirror: EMA100 falling; EMA45<EMA100, EMA8<EMA45; EMA3 crosses below EMA8; distance to EMA3 <=50 pips; same time filters
exit: grid-add every 10 pips fixed 0.01 lot continuation; step +0.01 lot every 4 losing adds; trailing stop 15/step1 activates once >=2 orders open; close-all when recovered profit >=3 USD; no SL/TP on individual orders
buildon_idea: already capped at 0.1 lot; run flat-lot (no step increase) baseline first to isolate the EMA-alignment entry edge from the grid mechanics, then try linear-add vs log lot law; consider adding a real SL per order
novelty_note: 4-EMA fan filter (fast>mid>slow alignment) plus fast-cross timing is a reasonable trend filter; grid/counter-trend-correction (engulfing-gated) mechanics are the channel's generic template. Backtest: EU, 5yr, $1000 start, >500% profit, 11,630 orders

title: EMA 4-line align + rising/falling grid multi-group (mq5, EU+Gold retest)
entry_long: EMA100 rising (ID1>ID2); EMA45>EMA100, EMA8>EMA45 fan alignment; EMA3 crosses above EMA8; price-to-EMA3 distance <=100 pips; spread filter <35; hour filter 13:00-20:00 server (UTC+2); weekday filter Mon,Tue,Thu,Fri (Wed excluded by creator preference, news avoidance)
entry_short: mirror falling EMA100, fan EMA45<EMA100<... , EMA3 crosses below EMA8, distance<=100 pips, same filters
exit: grid-add every 100 pips fixed 0.01 lot; step +0.01 every 5 losing adds; dynamic close-money = 5 + (order_count/5)*5 USD formula (scales close target with basket size to avoid closing at a loss); trailing stop present but exact value unspecified in this variant; max order cap 50; no SL/TP on individual orders
escalation_cap: 0.1 lot (Volume Upper Limit); step +0.01 every 5 orders; max 50 orders
buildon_idea: already capped; formula-based close-money that scales with basket size is a reusable module worth extracting; test flat-lot baseline and linear/log lot law swap before judging edge; also retest on XAUUSD since creator ran a full-year 2025 gold pass
novelty_note: mq5 rebuild of EX162 concept; dynamic close-money formula (avoids closing basket at a loss when many orders stacked) is the notable addition vs the mq4 version. Backtest: EU 5yr + separate XAUUSD full-year-2025 pass, ~11,300 orders on gold test

title: Daily profit-target auto-stop + pending-order martingale (based on example #97)
entry_long: buy-stop pending order placed price_offset=75 pips above current ask, lot=lot_BS (starts 0.1), one order per bar filter
entry_short: sell-stop pending order price_offset=75 pips below current bid, lot=lot_BS, one order per bar filter
exit: SL=150 pips on every order; close at +150 pips profit target (resets lot_BS to base 0.1); on SL hit, lot_BS *=2 (lot_x=2) for next order; opposite pending order deleted once one side fills; daily equity target = day-start balance * win% (e.g. 101=1%) computed once per day (Daily timeframe once-per-bar) — EA halts trading for the rest of the day once balance>=target, resumes with fresh day-start balance next day
escalation_cap: none stated (uncapped x2 doubling on consecutive daily SL hits, only bounded by the daily profit-stop halting further entries once target is hit)
buildon_idea: add a hard doubling-step cap (e.g. max 3-4 martingale steps) before forcing a pause; the daily-profit-lock block (record day-start balance, target=balance*win%, halt once reached, reset next day) is a reusable 3-4 block module the creator explicitly says can bolt onto any other EA in the catalog
novelty_note: the daily-profit-lock module itself is high novelty as a portable risk-control add-on; the underlying entry (breakout pending-order martingale) is generic and reused from example #97

title: Daily profit-target auto-stop + pending-order martingale v2 (SL/TP 500, offset 300)
entry_long: buy-stop pending order offset=300 pips above current price, lot=lot_BS (starts 0.1), SL=500 pips, TP=500 pips
entry_short: sell-stop pending order offset=300 pips below current price, lot=lot_BS, SL=500 pips, TP=500 pips
exit: TP hit (500 pips) closes and resets lot_BS to base 0.1; SL hit (500 pips) doubles lot_BS (x2) for next order; opposite pending order deleted once one side fills; daily target = day-start balance * win% (e.g. 101=1%) checked once per day, EA halts for remainder of day once balance>=target, resumes next day with new day-start balance
escalation_cap: none stated (uncapped x2 doubling on consecutive daily SL hits)
buildon_idea: add a hard martingale-step cap; same reusable daily-profit-lock module as the other EX164 variant, could be standardized and applied portfolio-wide; creator demoed disabling the on-chart comment blocks via Back Test Mode flag for faster backtesting
novelty_note: same daily-profit-lock concept as EX164/tl8F6rWIxIs but with wider SL/TP/offset (500/500/300 vs 150/150/75); creator ran a 6-month 2025 backtest with this config and reported it profitable but exact numbers not clearly stated

title: RSI two-level oversold/overbought reversal entry + multi-group grid recovery
entry_long: RSI(7) crosses below level 25 (arms buy signal, mode_buy=1) then later crosses back above level 30 (confirms reversal momentum) = open buy group1
entry_short: RSI(7) crosses above level 75 (arms sell signal) then crosses back below level 70 = open sell group2
exit: grid-add every 15 pips fixed 0.01 lot continuation, gated by bullish/bearish engulfing pattern before each add; step lot +0.01 every 4 losing adds; trailing stop 15/step1 activates once >=2 orders open (group-level, stops move together); close-all both groups when combined profit >=5 USD; save-mode cut-loss force-close at 30 orders/side (optional toggle); no SL/TP on individual orders
escalation_cap: 0.1 lot upper limit; step +0.01 every 4 orders; save-mode force-close at 30 orders/side
buildon_idea: already capped; flat-lot test first to isolate the RSI double-level entry edge from grid escalation; given only 32.8% profit / ~68% relative DD over 5yr un-optimized, try linear/log lot law and add a real SL before judging; the double-level (arm-then-confirm) RSI timing itself may be worth extracting as a standalone entry filter
novelty_note: RSI arm-then-confirm-crossback (25 then 30 / 75 then 70) is a decent whipsaw filter vs a plain single-level RSI cross; grid/engulfing-gated recovery is the channel's generic template. Backtest: EU 5yr 2020-2024, $1000 start, un-optimized, profit 32.8%, DD ~47.9%, relative DD 68.2%

title: Multi-group RSI+Bollinger Band trend-toggle scalping grid
entry_long: price (candle close) crosses above Lower Bollinger Band while RSI is oversold (<30) at that point = buy group1; only active if mode_buy toggle=true
entry_short: price crosses below Upper Bollinger Band while RSI is overbought (>70) = sell group2; only active if mode_sell toggle=true
exit: grid-add every 100 pips fixed 0.01 lot; step +0.01 lot every 5 losing adds; trailing stop base value scaled by ATR (ATR * telling_stop_base) for market-adaptive stop distance, trailing-step5; close-all at group profit > dynamic close-money formula (base 5 USD scaled by order count); max 50 orders/side pause; no SL/TP on individual orders
escalation_cap: 0.1 lot upper limit; step +0.01 every 5 orders; pause at 50 orders/side
buildon_idea: the buy-mode/sell-mode trend toggle is a clean, already-built lever to cut grid/DD exposure — test with only one side enabled matched to the prevailing trend, as the creator himself suggests; try linear/log lot instead of step-grid; already capped at 0.1 lot
novelty_note: combines BB band-touch with RSI extreme for entry plus a dynamic close-money formula that scales with basket size; the mode_buy/mode_sell trend-toggle for directional-only trading is a practical, creator-acknowledged build-on lever

title: Multi-group RSI+Bollinger Band scalping with candle-wick entry filter + ATR-adaptive trailing (student-submitted idea)
entry_long: candle low breaks below Lower Bollinger Band AND prior candle has a lower wick >=40% of candle size AND RSI(7)<30 at that point = buy
entry_short: candle high breaks above Upper Bollinger Band AND prior candle has an upper wick >=40% of candle size AND RSI(7)>70 = sell
exit: grid-add every 90 pips fixed continuation lot; step lot +0.01 every 4 losing adds; trailing stop distance = ATR * base(60 pips) * 2 multiplier (adaptive to market volatility), trailing-step5; close-all at group profit >=8 USD; per-order no SL/TP; unresolved stuck-order clearing logic runs after each basket close
escalation_cap: 0.1 lot upper limit; step +0.01 every 4 orders
buildon_idea: the 40%+ wick-length filter for confirming a BB-touch/RSI-extreme reversal is worth extracting as a standalone entry-quality gate to test on other signals in this catalog; the ATR-adaptive trailing-stop formula is a reusable module already reused elsewhere in this channel; already capped at 0.1 lot, try linear/log lot swap
novelty_note: candle-wick-proportion filter is a distinct refinement over plain BB/RSI touch entries (student-submitted idea per creator); ATR-scaled trailing stop (attributed by creator to an AI suggestion) is moderately novel. Backtest: full-year 2024, TF5min, ~4100 orders, spread16, $1000 start, profit 36%, DD 39.2%

title: Trailing-stop start-mode explainer: average-open-level / pips / custom-pips / percent-of-trailing-stop
entry_long: random-output block randomly opens buy or sell when no position exists (demo-only signal, not a real strategy)
entry_short: mirror random output triggers sell instead of buy
exit: demonstrates 4 trailing-stop 'start' modes: (1) average-open-level = midpoint of bid/ask, near-equivalent to no offset; (2) fixed pips (e.g. 50); (3) custom-pips = a variable/formula/indicator-driven reference (e.g. set to 150); (4) percent-of-trailing-stop (e.g. 100% = full trailing distance, 200% = double distance before activation). First order has SL set to 5-bar high/low; grid-add orders (every 100 pips) have no SL/TP, so they sit unprotected ('stuck') until trailing-stop activates once order count>=3
buildon_idea: n/a - tooling/education video; the transferable lesson is: give every order an individual SL/TP, or make trailing-stop activation timing match order cadence exactly, to avoid an unprotected 'stuck order' gap that can occur between grid adds and trailing-stop activation
novelty_note: not a trading strategy; documents a real gotcha (orders with no SL/TP sitting exposed before trailing-stop activates) that is directly relevant to every grid/martingale EA in this catalog's template
